1.g3 e5 2.a3 d5 3.Nf3 e4 4.Nh4 Be7 5.d3.strategy: A gambit that ignores the attacked knight and hits the e-pawn instead. ...Bxh4 gxh4 Qxh4 wins a pawn, wrecks White's kingside and puts the queen on h4, where it hits h2. The pressure on e4 does not make up for that.
1.g3 e5 2.a3 d5 3.Nf3 e4 4.Nh4 Be7 5.d3.name: Hungarian Opening: Burk Gambit
